title: Emacs Symbol Record
description: A record representing a single Emacs Lisp symbol and its metadata.

package.description: The package or feature that provides this symbol.

prefix.description: The conventional prefix for the package (e.g., 'magit-').

file.description: The absolute path to the source file where the symbol is defined.

line.description: The line number in the source file where the symbol is defined.

interactive.description: True if the symbol is an interactive command.

args.description: The argument list for a function or macro.

doc_excerpt.description: An excerpt of the symbol's docstring.

keybindings.description: A list of keybindings that invoke this symbol.

provides.description: A list of features this symbol's file provides.

requires.description: A list of features this symbol's file requires.

last_modified.description: The Unix timestamp of when the source file was last modified.
